quotaDecision.reason: Per explicit user instruction, this dataset uses the exact per-skill counts the user provided (5 Interpretative + 6 Procedural = 11). The portal's own mapped minimums were NOT used to size this dataset - recorded in specialty-config/procedural-nutrition.json for traceability only.

competenceLevelHandling: "Administration of nasogastric / nasojejunal feeding" has ONLY level 4 as a portal-valid competence value, so all 3 of its rows correctly use level 4 (expected, not a bug). The other 3 Procedural skills each have exactly 1 row despite having 2 valid competence levels - the level was NOT multiplied into extra rows. See procedural_competenceLevelUsage in row-count-summary.json for the exact level used per skill.
surgicalNutritionRealism: Every case ties to a surgical or perioperative nutritional-support scenario (preoperative/postoperative nutritional assessment, enteral tube feeding, feeding gastrostomy/jejunostomy, PEG tube, and parenteral nutrition access) rather than an unrelated generic diet-clinic case.
